# Custos node bundle: cluster e2e, revision 7

Isolation mode: `namespace`. Mount timeout: 30s.

This bundle installs root-run Slurm Prolog/Epilog scripts that mount NFS
shares for Custos tenants. It was generated by Custos from the cluster node
configuration; do not edit files on the node, change the configuration in
Custos instead (see docs/node-hooks.md).

## Contents

- `etc/custos/node/mounts.tsv` - mount table (tab separated; parsed by the scripts).
- `etc/custos/node/lib/common.sh` - shared shell helpers.
- `etc/custos/node/prolog.d/` - Prolog scripts. Slurm runs `Prolog=/dir/*` in
  reverse alphabetical order, so a higher number runs first.
  `900-custos-mounts` always runs first; custom hooks are named
  `<800-order>-<name>` so a lower `order` runs earlier.
- `etc/custos/node/epilog.d/` - Epilog scripts, same ordering rule. Custom
  hooks are `<800-order>-<name>`; `100-custos-unmount` always runs last.
- `etc/custos/node/ns-clone.sh`, `etc/custos/node/ns-epilog.sh` - namespace/linux hooks.
- `etc/custos/node/custos-node-sync` - pull agent (optional).
- `etc/systemd/system/custos-node-sync.{service,timer}` - agent units.

## Install (manual)

1. As root, unpack and install the node tree (`-p` keeps the root-only modes):

   ```sh
   tar -xpzf custos-node-e2e-r7.tar.gz -C /
   stat -c '%a %U %n' /etc/custos/node /etc/custos/node/mounts.tsv
   ```

   The `stat` output must show `700 root` for the directory and `600 root` for
   `mounts.tsv`. The tree is root-only because `mounts.tsv` names every tenant's
   shares and the account-to-tenant map; Slurm runs all of these scripts as root.

2. Add the following to `slurm.conf` and restart slurmd (`scontrol reconfigure`
   is not enough for PrologFlags):

   ```text
   Prolog=/etc/custos/node/prolog.d/*
   Epilog=/etc/custos/node/epilog.d/*
   PrologFlags=Alloc,Contain
   NamespaceType=namespace/linux
   ```

3. Namespace mode needs Slurm 25.11 or newer with cgroup v2. Create
   `namespace.yaml` next to `slurm.conf` (never list NFS targets under
   `dirs` or `dir_confs`):

   ```yaml
   defaults:
     auto_base_path: true
     base_path: /var/nvme/storage
     clone_ns_script: /etc/custos/node/ns-clone.sh
     clone_ns_epilog: /etc/custos/node/ns-epilog.sh
     clone_ns_script_wait: 35
     clone_ns_epilog_wait: 35
   ```

   `clone_ns_script_wait` must be at least the mount timeout plus 5 seconds.

## Pull agent (optional)

Delivery by hand works; `custos-node-sync` keeps nodes current instead.

1. Create a node token in Custos (`POST /api/v1/clusters/e2e/node-tokens`)
   and store it, root-only, on the node:

   ```sh
   install -m 0600 /dev/null /etc/custos/node-token
   # write the token into /etc/custos/node-token
   ```

2. Create `/etc/custos/agent.conf` (mode 0600):

   ```text
   CUSTOS_URL=https://custos.example.org
   CUSTOS_TOKEN_FILE=/etc/custos/node-token
   CUSTOS_CA_FILE=/etc/custos/ca.pem
   ```

3. Enable the timer:

   ```sh
   systemctl daemon-reload
   systemctl enable --now custos-node-sync.timer
   ```

The agent turns `/etc/custos/node` into a symlink to
`/var/lib/custos-node/releases/<sha256>` and flips it atomically; an existing
real directory is kept as `/etc/custos/node.pre-custos-agent`.

## Failure behaviour

Scripts fail closed. A non-zero Prolog exit requeues the job and drains the
node; a non-zero Epilog exit drains the node, which is the intended signal
when a tenant mount cannot be released. Logs go to syslog (`custos-node`).
